design_source: docs/design.md: 五人系统与免费规则
scope: 26 literal HasMallItem tags;133 actual calls; no platform requests, code edits or game launch.

phase_contract.Selecting: No grants, passive income/growth or claims.
phase_contract.Starting: Authorized uY/ux/u7 setup can create helpers/pets/courier, grant starterkits and apply configured VIP attributes exactly once/player/run. Do not gate this only onPlaying.
phase_contract.Playing: Recurring gains and user claims require phasePlaying, active player/roster, proper mode and intended milestone/action identity.

VIP0.label: 烂铁祝福
VIP0.effect: ux/u7 one random I2[4] puzzle and one random C-grade active/passive skillbook; full-set component.
VIP0.proposed_free_rule: Explicit cumulative preset: one VIP0 source kit per run, keep real opening/skill RNG.
VIP0.guards_and_growth: Once/player/run during Starting; separate VIP0 C-book and BOOKC can deliberately each give one, record quantity.

VIP1.label: 黄金祝福
VIP1.effect: uY reroll+2, monster cap+15, money efficiency+5%, XP+10%, drop+15%, R005; BQg/BRz double genuine clear points.
VIP1.proposed_free_rule: Explicit cumulative free preset, apply attributes once and use real reward triggers.
VIP1.guards_and_growth: Initialize once/player/run; remove cap contribution once on leave; settlement idempotence.

VIP2.label: 白金祝福
VIP2.effect: uY cap+15, money efficiency+5%, XP+10%, R002; BBq keep/replace existing skill dialogs; equipment-upgrade failure10-50%refund via R002.
VIP2.proposed_free_rule: Cumulative preset; preserve original upgrade costs/refund RNG; add fifth dialogs before enabling.
VIP2.guards_and_growth: Initialize once; one physical book use/choice; validate dialog owner and pending token.

VIP3.label: 钻石祝福
VIP3.effect: uY post-revive protection10 vs default5; R000 half revive time; starting puzzle pack;10s overflow grace; doubled earned mastery in v4/wR/BQm/BR1 capped500.
VIP3.proposed_free_rule: Cumulative preset per effect; preserve mode and active-roster conditions, original triggers.
VIP3.guards_and_growth: Starting kit once; hero mastery earned normally, never initialize500; settlement once.

PTLB.label: 拼图礼包
PTLB.effect: ux/u7 give I02Y; BBy21221 opens4% large puzzle else2-5 random puzzles; owner-locked.
PTLB.proposed_free_rule: One free PTLB source pack/run, preserve opening RNG; VIP3 is another explicit source if preset enabled.
PTLB.guards_and_growth: No regrant on reroll/repeated initialization. Preserve permanent puzzle unlock/strengthening.

LWJ.label: 老玩家回归豪礼
LWJ.effect: ux/u7 give I05Z if !LWJT. BBy21246 manual use boosts3 random non-HFS heroes to500 and HGG/HFS. Legacy anti-cheat also checks tag.
LWJ.proposed_free_rule: Free manual original I05Z entry, once/independent profile; default unopened. Remove enforcement branches separately.
LWJ.guards_and_growth: Durable isolated LWJT flag; atomically reserve gift and mark use. No bulk auto-claim. Fix counter double increment and1..148 range.

S1CB.label: 第1赛季仙境之翼
S1CB.effect: uY sets R0061; A0CC Requires R0061; BSN37558..37564 selected wing damage+14%. A0CG is placeholder.
S1CB.proposed_free_rule: Free actual A0CC selection, no fabricated historical rank.
S1CB.guards_and_growth: Normal wing exclusive: remove old effect/stat delta first. A0CG unknown placeholder is not verified playable.

S1ZQ.label: 第1赛季大红龙
S1ZQ.effect: uY R00I1; A0LW; BR9 mount ID7,8% reduction while mounted.
S1ZQ.proposed_free_rule: Free collection unlock; shared prerequisite at least1.
S1ZQ.guards_and_growth: One active mount; remove old mounted ability and replace AFC40A99/74CDE3A7.

S1CH.label: 第1赛季混乱制造者
S1CH.effect: Inside S1ZQ branch uY upgrades R00I2; A0LX; BSQ37715 title crit+3%, critical multiplier+0.5.
S1CH.proposed_free_rule: Free title selection, set shared prerequisite2 once; also satisfies mount1.
S1CH.guards_and_growth: One gameplay title: restore base name and subtract previous FE31C9A2/EE0573CF before apply.

S2ZQ.label: 生命摇篮坐骑
S2ZQ.effect: uY disables A0O4 when absent; BR9 ID10, A0O3 mounted ability,7% reduction while mounted.
S2ZQ.proposed_free_rule: Free selectable mount; leave A0O4 enabled.
S2ZQ.guards_and_growth: Normal one-mount replacement; no stacked reductions.

TXZ.label: 沙河通行证
TXZ.effect: uY enables In/R00K, loads TGDS and R004 tiers50/150/300/500/800/1200. BQg/BRz award5+difficulty per genuine clear. BRd rewards A..G.
TXZ.proposed_free_rule: Free access, TGDS starts0, ordinary clears earn points capped1200; retain thresholds and real rewards.
TXZ.guards_and_growth: Correct BRc/BRd grouping: (direct OR bulk) AND !claimed AND tier. Seven once/run claimflags; no initial maxing.

TRE.label: 迷你泰瑞尔
TRE.effect: ux/u7 h034 replaces camel h00I in same courier handle52513C84. Kv every100s calls vq to produce I2[6] item.
TRE.proposed_free_rule: Free one courier skin/service; preserve100s production and intended alternate-mode source.
TRE.guards_and_growth: Create once Starting; production only Playing/active. One courier, no duplicate timer per player.

PET1.label: 九尾狐
PET1.effect: v1/v8/wK e00U handleADC2CB6C; every30s +10STR/AGI/INT,+1%damage. A0DD4-state display/stats toggle.
PET1.proposed_free_rule: Free access; create once Starting; one stored growth timer. PET1/PET2 can coexist.
PET1.guards_and_growth: (state0 OR state1) AND Playing/active/alive/mode. Toggle state does not create extra timers; no Selecting growth.

PET2.label: 冰雪小宠
PET2.effect: v1/wK n01G handle535F5C27;30s update attack=hero attack18+19; show/hide chat.
PET2.proposed_free_rule: Free separate pet, one unit and one timer, same original attack tracking.
PET2.guards_and_growth: Playing/active gate for recurring update; no duplicate unit; fifth show/hide registrations required.

IMBAG.label: 无尽黄金魔袋
IMBAG.effect: Startup IL[ConvertedId]; baseLv0; zC pays lumber for upgrade to10. Kill threshold400-10*level; reward5000..15000gold,20+5*level allstats; persists/reset counter; efficiency10+4*level%.
IMBAG.proposed_free_rule: Free base bag once/run; preserve original kill cycles, lumber costs and cap.
IMBAG.guards_and_growth: One golden bag carried across families. Fifth IL6 missing; independent item clone and rawcode predicates required.

3FJT.label: 第三座方尖塔
3FJT.effect: ux/u7 give I06O construction item; Jc/BOB tower random-skill initialization.
3FJT.proposed_free_rule: One free third-tower token/run; preserve location/lane ownership and random tower behavior.
3FJT.guards_and_growth: Starting source flag, consumed token once; do not duplicate first/second timed towers.

BOOKD.label: 普通/D级技能书
BOOKD.effect: ux10141/u710650 give50/50 I01J active/I01O passive, consume original Boolean42 quantity1; learns random skill replacing slot.
BOOKD.proposed_free_rule: One explicit free BOOKD source/run; keep original synchronized learning RNG/choice and local item consumption.
BOOKD.guards_and_growth: No platform balance/Boolean42 consumption; no repeated starter grants.

BOOKC.label: C级技能书
BOOKC.effect: ux10150/u710659 give50/50 I01K/I01P; automatic mode branch can grant without ownership yet still calls Boolean42.
BOOKC.proposed_free_rule: One explicit free BOOKC source/run, merge auto-mode and free source into same claim.
BOOKC.guards_and_growth: VIP0 C-book can be separate source; reroll/repeated init cannot mint another BOOKC.

BOOKB.label: B级技能书
BOOKB.effect: ux10159/u710668 give50/50 I01L/I01Q then local random learning/overwrite; Boolean42 quantity1.
BOOKB.proposed_free_rule: One explicit free BOOKB source/run; retain original learn/overwrite mechanics.
BOOKB.guards_and_growth: Source token/run and physical item consumption; no cloudstock.

BOOKA.label: A级技能书
BOOKA.effect: ux10168/u710677 give50/50 I01M/I01R then local random learning/overwrite; Boolean42 quantity1.
BOOKA.proposed_free_rule: One explicit free BOOKA source/run; retain original learn/overwrite mechanics.
BOOKA.guards_and_growth: Source token/run and physical item consumption; no cloudstock.

BAG3.label: 黄金魔袋Lv3
BAG3.effect: ux10177/u710686 give I08L;20%efficiency, consume after400kills for7000..12000gold,+20..40stats. u7 auto mode1.
BAG3.proposed_free_rule: One free BAG3 source/run, auto mode shares same token, delete Boolean42 consume.
BAG3.guards_and_growth: One carried golden bag with IMBAG; keep token/storage if conflict; preserve400kills/RNG.

TXCH1.label: 沙河梦新春
TXCH1.effect: v1/wK initial red-envelope RNG; v3 every5wave, wL every300s alternate mode; BSS -txch1 overhead model.
TXCH1.proposed_free_rule: Free cosmetic and original scheduled rewards; cosmetic switch never replays reward.
TXCH1.guards_and_growth: One reward per stage/tick/player; replace shared7D1DD015 effect; no Selecting income.

ZBQ1.label: 秘籍
ZBQ1.effect: v3/wB three independent1.5% rolls each+66STR/AGI/INT at scheduled minute/wave boundary.
ZBQ1.proposed_free_rule: Free same scheduled effect, preserve synchronized RNG/cadence.
ZBQ1.guards_and_growth: One roll set per real milestone/player; no initial stats or reroll-trigger rewards.

JBLB.label: 金币礼包
JBLB.guards_and_growth: E0FA2E6F false→true before grant, disable A0EF; nested original guard sound. Playing only.

MCLB.label: 木材礼包
MCLB.effect: BQp A0EG or A0O2 gives+3allstats and I03P reincarnation cross; code grants no lumber.
MCLB.proposed_free_rule: Free direct/bulk once/run, preserve actual effect.
MCLB.guards_and_growth: 0AFCD4EA false→true before grant, disable A0EG; nested original guard sound. Playing only.

S2CH.label: 苍茫万壑特效称号
S2CH.proposed_free_rule: Free cosmetic selector; no stat-bearing BSQ title or reward replay.
S2CH.guards_and_growth: Destroy/replace shared overhead effect, no stacking.
